card.title: I Told You Enough
card.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll be honest about my birthday. When you rang, I was eating dinner alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brother posted a photo from our kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He came for dessert. By dinner, I mean the main course.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's beside you while you're carving the chicken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carving isn't eating. I meant the moments when food was actually in my mouth.

mechanism: A keeps reducing what eating dinner alone includes to preserve a claimed truthful account under photographic challenge.
confusable: Unlike flat denial of evidence, A must move the definitions of dinner and eating as B makes the question precise.
comparison: A photograph forces distinctions between dessert, carving and mouthfuls, rather than the bank scene's locations of arrival.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
